parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.quoteId||!b.token||!b.acceptedBy)throw new Error('acceptance evidence required');const evidenceType=$env.CUSTOMER_EVIDENCE_MODE==='customer_verified'?'customer_verified':'simulated';return[{json:{...b,evidenceType,tokenHash:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b.token).digest('hex')}}];

parameters.query: WITH t AS(UPDATE quote_acceptance_tokens SET used_at=now() WHERE quote_id=$1 AND token_hash=$2 AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at>now() RETURNING quote_id,quote_version),q AS(UPDATE quotes SET status='accepted',updated_at=now() FROM t WHERE id=t.quote_id AND version=t.quote_version AND status='sent' AND valid_until>now() RETURNING id,version,currency,total_minor),a AS(INSERT INTO customer_acceptances(quote_id,quote_version,acceptance_token_hash,accepted_by,accepted_at,evidence_type)SELECT id,version,$2,$3,now(),$4 FROM q ON CONFLICT(acceptance_token_hash)DO NOTHING RETURNING quote_id,quote_version),i AS(INSERT INTO invoices(invoice_number,quote_id,quote_version,currency,total_minor,balance_minor,status,issued_at)SELECT 'INV-'||to_char(now(),'YYYYMMDD')||'-'||substr(q.id::text,1,8),q.id,q.version,q.currency,q.total_minor,q.total_minor,'open',now() FROM q JOIN a ON a.quote_id=q.id RETURNING id,invoice_number)INSERT INTO audit_log(entity_type,entity_id,actor,action,details)SELECT 'invoice',id,$3,'invoice_issued',jsonb_build_object('invoice_number',invoice_number,'evidence',$4)FROM i RETURNING entity_id;
